visible_evidence.detail: Selecting the activity run card shows the run detail panel.
The panel header shows Claude, PLAN-214, Q&A read-only clone, start time, In progress, and elapsed time.
The panel has a close button, and the activity run card remains available to reopen it.
A drag boundary between work item and panel changes panel width.
The panel groups thoughts and actions under Working with step count.
Selecting Synced the clone reveals its command result.
The Working group can collapse its thought and tool rows.
The panel shows a loading indicator and working text after the latest action.
Plan shows 1 of 4, time estimate, completed, current, and remaining tasks.
Selecting Plan hides or reveals its task list.
Queue shows one waiting message and states that it sends after the current step.
Selecting Queue hides or reveals queued items.
The waiting message has Send now.
The waiting message has a close button.
The run composer says Queue a message for Claude and its send button says Queue this message.
The run composer offers Stop the current action and take over, with sandbox kept.
The panel says Kevin stopped the action, kept sandbox and worktree, discarded one queued message, and waits for direction.
The run asks which clone to read and says no write occurred.
The elicitation shows plane and plane-fork remotes with their local clone paths.
The paused panel provides a reply field and Send.
The run shows Finished, answer summary, a response in the panel, and a response comment in Activity.
Completed tool activity is grouped as Worked for 3s and starts collapsed.
The panel shows Code job, six completed plan steps, approval records, tests, and a draft pull request.
The run shows repository PR #482, Draft, branch, diff size, and human merge note.
The panel holds before the first write, names two files and the worktree, and shows a Needs approval card.
The write request offers Allow for this run.
The write request offers Allow once.
The write request offers Deny.
The run shows failed preflight, no container, expired credentials, and a comment with login guidance.
The run says no update for five minutes and warns that the worker is probably down.
The run reports two of two code jobs, no queue, and no new container.
Workspace settings > Integrations shows GitHub and Claude Code, Codex CLI, Grok CLI, and Omp cards with connection states.
The detail shows enabled-by, scopes, connection installations, personal account, and PR defaults.
GitHub detail has Disconnect.
Each listed GitHub installation has Remove.
Connections has Connect organisation.
Open pull requests as drafts is enabled.
Post run conclusions as PR comments is disabled.
Branch format shows agent/identifier.
After Disconnect, Integrations shows an install prompt and Authenticate with GitHub.
After Authenticate with GitHub, the page shows device URL, code, expiry, I entered the code, and Cancel.
The device pairing state has I entered the code.
The device pairing state has Cancel.
The agent detail page lists Claude, Codex, Grok, and Omp with handles and connection states.
Agent detail shows a Mentionable switch.
Agent detail shows an editable Name field.
Agent detail shows an editable Instructions area.
A connected agent has a model selector with model choices.
Codex detail shows failed login, no model, and Retry.
Retry shows Connecting and then Connected, with model selection available.
Connected agent detail shows Disconnect.
A disconnected or idle agent detail shows Connect.
New project shows cover, name, identifier, description, privacy, and lead fields.
New project lists repositories from granted GitHub accounts.
Owner buttons filter the repository list to the selected owner.
Selecting mini-labs/plane-ee marks it Selected and shows cloning to a mirror path.
The form says agents cannot be mentioned without a repository working directory.
The form shows Create project.
The form shows Cancel.
Selecting Claude in the suggestion list opens the In progress run scene.
The suggestion list includes Codex; its handler opens the In progress run scene.
The repository section shows No GitHub connection and directs an admin to Workspace settings > Integrations.
The detail page has an Integrations back button.
The agent detail page has an Integrations back button.
